profile.headline: Senior Full Stack Engineer | Problem Solver
profile.summary:
Curious and critical-thinking Cloud-native Front-end developer with Full Stack experience combined with team leadership and management experience. Adept at collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software solutions. Proven ability to design and implement scalable solutions across a variety of languages, conduct code reviews, and troubleshoot software issues. High communication skills.
Skills: React, Node.js, Next.js, AWS, Python, Django, PHP

I enjoy solving problems in any form and finding most optimized way to solve them. I began my devlopment journey early in high school with classes in VB and C++, but in college generally put programming aside while I completed my Physics degree. After almost a year doing international travel and visiting 15+ countries, software was always on the back of my mind. I re-sparked my love and interest for developement and problem solving and it has been my career path since. I am also interested in sustainability, environmental awareness, and life-long learning.

positions.title: Software Engineer - UI Developer
positions.description:
Contracted out as key engineer on multiple high-impact financial projects for Broadridge Financial Solutions, averaging 6-month contracts.
    • Contributed to the complete rewrite of a React/TypeScript trading application focusing on equity/FX trading, compliance, and real-time data analytics. Delivered a Demo-Ready MVP in 5 months, significantly reducing maintenance overhead.
    • Played a central role in developing a Monorepo architecture for front-end microservices, improving scalability and performance.
    • Collaborated on building a descriptive and informative SDK and CLI for the Monorepo to streamline and accelerate development and increase internal framework adoption.
    • Optimized CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and deployed a cloud-based framework on AWS EC2 to support team collaboration.
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · JavaScript · React.js · Node.js · Next.js · Tailwind CSS · React Hooks

positions.title: Full Stack Software Developer
positions.description:
• Developed new and complex features as part of a small, integrated team using React, TypeScript, PHP, Python, Django, and AWS services.
• Mentored junior engineers and conducted in-depth code reviews. 
• Took on management responsibilities, overseeing team tasks, product roadmaps, and Jira workflows.
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · React.js · Postgres · PHP · Django · Python (Programming Language) · Next.js

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Same duties outlined in the below Software Developer position with slight shift in focus. 

Remote work in a relaxed Agile team environment. Main focuses were React, Node, webpack framework, work assignment in Jira, and managed code reviews & version control via Git/BitBucket with CI/CD. Designed and implemented a custom login component utilizing a custom AWS Cognito configuration in our React web app. RedAwning.com bought Blizzard (below) in April 2018. Our team began officially reporting to the Seattle tech team remotely in Sept. 2019 and payroll changes were made in Dec. of 2019.

company.name: Blizzard Internet Marketing - A RedAwning Group Brand

positions.title: Developer
positions.description: Full stack LAMP software development (Linux-Apache-MySQL-PHP). Front end: JS, jQuery, HTML/CSS/Sass. Built new features on and debugged/maintained existing features on 40+ stand-alone apps – the Blizzard Reservation Engine - connecting to 6 different APIs and version controlled by git/bitbucket. Once bought by RedAwning, began working with React, Node, webpack and AWS libraries maintaining current components and building new ones. All development is CI/CD. Began working in a remote team environment.

positions.title: Project Coordinator
positions.description: Originally hired as a contractor to transition the company to a new project management software, I soon transitioned to full-time. Assisted the Hosting department in troubleshooting and maintaining the Apache servers on Linux OS, and assisted the Software Development and Web Developemt departments by implementing bug fixes in PHP, JS, jQuery, and database work in MySQL. Volunteered briefly to act as the WordPress Project Manager and was the Administrator for our project management software.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Gained exposure to the SDLC, built and maintained a development environment, exposure to coding in Java using Eclipse in a Linux environment with Ubuntu OS. Utilized tools such as subversion, Jira, Play! framework, and Scrum team development.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Gained research experience in the field of Bose-Einstein Condensates in  AMO physics. Assembled low-power lasers used to excite rubidium atoms in a rubidium cell. Built and executed code in Maple for graphically visualizing the bound energy states of a spherical potential well. Perform new, exciting, and innovative research on the effect of light-polarized dipoles on spin-exchange collisions.

volunteerExperiences.companyName: Alpha Phi Omega National Service Fraternity
volunteerExperiences.description: Joined this service fraternity as a freshman at Colorado State University and while helping grow the fraternity from 12 to 60+ members during my career at CSU, held various leadership positions: Alumni Relations Coordinator for 2 years and Inter-Chapter Corresponding Secretary. Service in all aspects of society such as environmental work, education, poverty, animal welfare, cultural events, and working with local nonprofit organizations.

company.name: Alpha Phi Omega National Service Fraternity
